definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts an NF-kappaB-mediated signaling cascade in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host NF-kappaB cascade
